10:
Oh, this is just terrible!  I sent out my top assistant, Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, into the desert southeast of here.  That's an area we call the Gaping Chasm.  Well, he's gone missing, and his last report had more of those weird bugs where he was.  Could it be that they've infested two major regions of the desert now?

I need you to head into the Gaping Chasm and look for Scrimshank, please!  That... or at least find his surveying equipment.  I fear that may be all that is left of the poor sod.
Discover the fate of Junior Surveyor Scrimshank, and bring either him or his surveying equipment to Senior Surveyor Fizzledowser in Gadgetzan.
60:
Hello, good sir!  Do you have a moment?

My brother and I run an apothecary in Stormwind, and I'm here to gather large candles for their wax.  Can you help me?

You can get large candles from kobolds, and I hear rumors that kobolds are infesting the Elwynn mines ... the Fargodeep mine to the south and Jasperlode Mine to the east.  I suggest looking for candles in one of those places.
Bring 8 Large Candles to William Pestle in Goldshire.
110:
I'm going to spend some time taking a look at Scrimshank's surveying gear... as well as putting his personal effects in order.  I get the sneaking feeling behind my ears that this isn't the last loss we'll be facing against these bugs.

I'd like for you to check in with Alchemist Pestlezugg to see if he has had a chance to process the insect parts we sent him.  If they're ready, bring them to me.
Check in Gadgetzan for Alchemist Pestlezugg and his analysis of the insect parts.
160:
Take this note to Ello Ebonlocke, the Mayor of Darkshire.

He and I are old friends...and when he reads it and discovers what you did for me...I'm sure he'll be just as happy as I am!  Hahahaha!
Bring Abercrombie's Letter to Ello Ebonlocke, Mayor of Darkshire.
210:
I do most of the cooking at the camp.  And it used to be a lot of work, until I bought a mechanical cooking pot from a goblin merchant in Booty Bay.  The pot is a wonder!  It saved me countless hours...until it broke!

Can you take the pot back to the goblin for me so he can fix it?  His name is Krazek.
Bring Krazek's Crock Pot to Krazek the goblin.
310:
I have to admit, those Thunderbrews make some good drinks. But they need to learn that theirs isn't the only decent brew! Maybe you can help me teach them that lesson...

Here, take this barrel of Barleybrew Scalder. Sneak into the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos and switch it with one of their barrels of Thunder Ale. Then we'll see how their patrons like my brew over theirs!

And if the barrels are guarded, then you might have to distract the guard...
In the basement of the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos, replace a barrel of Thunder Ale with a Barrel of Barleybrew Scalder.
360:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
Return to Magistrate Sevren in Brill.
410: This is an old, beaten, bloody table.
460:
You don't look like a rot hide.  Good.  I had lost hope...

My name is Alaric, and I was once Thule's head servant and bodyguard.  He used his magic to "protect" me from the Plague of Undeath, but instead his spell gave me an unlife from which I cannot escape.  And after creating the cursed rot hide gnolls, Thule beheaded me... and gave my head to the gnolls as a plaything!

Please, take me to my body.  I believe the gnolls buried it here in Fenris Keep, near the stable, in an unmarked grave.
Bring Alaric's Head to his grave.
510:
Among these documents is a list of requested supplies.  These include mundane items (food, weapons, clothing) as well as more exotic gear (masks, oil, poison).

But what is most notable is the urgency of the request - these supplies were needed soon in order to undertake what is described in the document as an "important mission against Southshore."
Bring the Foreboding Plans to Magistrate Maleb in Southshore.
560: You know, {name}, I'd really rather not take these heads... Since you've already got a handle on them, would you mind delivering them to Redpath for me?
Deliver the sack of murloc heads to Marshall Redpath in Southshore.
610:
My FATHER sent you? I'd have thought that old codger would have given up on me by now.

It wasn't really his fault I ran off, he just shouldn't have expected I'd be willing to live a boring life, reading over musty books and associating with grey-haired, stiff-backed, stuffy mages!

If you need my dagger, you'll have to get it back from "Pretty Boy" Duncan, one of the Bloodsail Buccaneers. Put something 'tween his shoulders and I'm sure he'll give it up.
Get Catelyn's dagger from "Pretty Boy" Duncan.
660:
All right, {name}. I'm ready if you are.

Shall we?
Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
710:
Here in the Badlands I've stopped to work on my latest project: my shackles of elemental binding.

When complete, they will allow mages to summon even more powerful elementals for use in even greater capacities. To start things off, I need small stone shards to test some of my newest offensive spells along with a few gizmos I've pieced together.

The shards are easily collected from the lesser rock elementals to the west of here. Could you bring me some?
Find 10 Small Stone Shards and bring them to Lotwil Veriatus in the Badlands.
760:
Your cleansing of the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn wells is spoken among the spirits, young {name}. The Wildmane Totem is made, and your last task lies ahead.

The Wildmane Water Well lies north of Thunder Bluff. Perform the ritual! Heal the land of the goblins' poisons! Let clean water flow once again!
Use the Wildmane Cleansing Totem at the Wildmane Water Well, then return to Mull Thunderhorn.
810:
You would do well to learn how dangerous this land can be, {class}.

The wildlife here can teach us such things... if we are wise and observant.

The scorpids are a perfect example of survival in Durotar. If you are to survive, it would be wise to take on some of their characteristics as your own. Their hardened carapaces can protect you from the harshness of the sun, or even a deadly weapon.

Bring me 6 Small Scorpid Carapaces from the Clattering Scorpids, {name}, and I shall see about rewarding you justly.
860:
If you wish to walk the hunter's path, then your journey leads to the Barrens.  Its beasts are strong-willed and fierce.  You will learn much by hunting there, and your spirit will grow.

Speak with Sergra Darkthorn.  She will be your first guide in the Barrens.

Sergra is at the Crossroads.  To reach her, travel east from Bloodhoof Village into the Barrens, then north as the road forks.  And have care as you travel--the Barrens holds great danger for the unprepared and unwary.
Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.
1010:
There is a plant that once grew in the old ruins of Bathran's Haunt to the north.  The plant was called Bathran's Hair and was known to cure ailments of the spirit.

There is a sick child in the village, and I believe it is more than just a physical illness.  Will you go to Bathran's Haunt and search it for Bathran's Hair?  I may need it to properly treat the child.

Bathran's Haunt lies north of Maestra's Post and just south of the border to Darkshore.
Bring 5 Bathran's Hair to Orendil Broadleaf in Ashenvale.
1060:
You've done so well for me, {name}. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.

He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.
Deliver Darsok's letter to Jin'Zil within his cave in Malaka'Jin, in Stonetalon.
1110:
Heh heh, with all the races they're running here, it's no surprise that a few mishaps happen along the way.  If you look around the Shimmering Flats then you'll see evidence of past crashes -- scraps of rocket car parts are littered everywhere!

And those parts are worth money to the gnomes and goblins.  They're always looking for more contraptions to slap onto their cars.

So go out and get me parts.  Bring me a heap and I'll pay you well.
Bring 30 Rocket Car Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
1160:
I will tell you what you must seek, and I will even ask you my question, but not because you wish to prove yourself. Knowledge is far more important than strength. Even as others seem to pass you by in ability, your knowledge of the world will be more valuable.

Go to the Monastery in the north of Tirisfal Glades. In the library there, a book called Beginnings of the Undead Threat resides. It was used by the now-corrupt paladins there to train them to fight my kind.

Bring it to me.
Find The Beginnings of the Undead Threat, and return it to Parqual Fintallas in Undercity.
1260:
I'm developing a new menu for the restaurant.  It will be filled with rural dishes with a "bayou" theme.  I think my clientele at the Blue Recluse will love them!

I sent my nephew Morgan to Theramore, a city on the edge of the Dustwallow Marsh.  He's there gathering recipes from the locals, and I must know what he found so far.

The trip to Theramore is long.  Too long for me.  But I bet a young {class} like yourself would jump at the chance to travel, yes?
Speak with Morgan Stern in Theramore.
1360:
I had myself a fine job as a digger at the Uldaman excavation site in the Badlands... that is until those blasted troggs showed up.  I escaped with my hide barely intact, and nothing else.  In the chaos, I left my most treasured possession.  It's safe from the troggs in my chest, sure, but it's right in the thick of 'em.

I'd be in your debt, both in honor and coin, if you could fetch it for me!  A chest with my name on it is at the end of the North Common Hall.  That's the one you need to get in.
Get Krom Stoutarm's treasured possession from his chest in the North Common Hall of Uldaman, and bring it to him in Ironforge.
1560:
I am so lost!

My wife, Torta, sent me out to fetch dinner and I must have taken a wrong turn somewhere.

Would you be so kind as to lead me back to Torta? She's waiting for me just south of Steamwheedle Port.
Show Tooga the way back to his wife, Torta.
2160:
Hey! You look like a hearty adventurer. If you're planning on braving the pass, do you suppose you could bring a package to the inn in Kharanos?

You were planning on stopping at the inn, right? If you make it through the pass, you'll definitely want to take a breather there.

Anyways, bring this to Tannok Frosthammer, the innkeeper's assistant. I can't get through the pass myself, and it'll be days until a Mountaineer escort comes through!
Deliver the Crate of Inn Supplies to Tannok Frosthammer in Kharanos.
3510:
She kills my children, mortal. She that calls herself the ruler of these oceans. A false god, nothing more. Crush her and bring back all of her heads.

For that, you will be given the name that you seek and something else of equal importance.

She roams the clutch... Hetaera she is called.

<Lord Arkkoroc points to the southwest.>

Go!
Slay Hetaera and bring back Hetaera's Bloodied Head, Hetaera's Beaten Head, and Hetaera's Bruised Head to Lord Arkkoroc.
3910: Welcome to Gadgetzan!  Take us home...
4110:
A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption.  My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.

When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon.  In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.
4510:
{name}, your help has been immeasurable.  The time will come, no doubt, when I'll ask for your assistance against the silithid once more.  We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.

Take this note to Idriana at the bank.  She'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude.  Thank you for your assistance, brave {class}.
Bring the Bank Voucher to Idriana in the bank of Darnassus.
4810: Ok, everything is prepared and packed and ready for transport!  Good luck in your journey, and make sure you tell Tinkee that she owes me!
Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.
5060:
An extremely sturdy cabinet stands before you, securely fastened shut by a built-in lock.  The front of the cabinet is deeply scratched and marked.  This could be surmised as being from numerous and violent failed attempts to reveal whatever secrets the cabinet currently obfuscates from view.

If you are going to open this cabinet, you will need to find the key.
5160:
Travel to Kalimdor, {race}. Our flight makes its home in the frigid landscape of Winterspring. Once you reach Winterspring, find the caves of Mazthoril.

Upon the icy floors of Mazthoril you will find cobalt runes. Hold one of my scales and stand upon a rune and you shall be transported to Haleh, our matron protectorate.

Give her the scale so that she may scry what it is I have seen and felt, here in this doomed place.
Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.
5210:
The Annals of Darrowshire, through my magic, has gained pages at its end, and now it extends its history beyond the battle.  One of the extra passages tells of another Redpath, Carlin, who survived Joseph's betrayal.  Carlin's now in the Plaguelands to the east, at the Light's Hope Chapel.

Take the book and speak with him.
Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.
5510:
A Minion's Scourgestone is the insignia of the Scourge rank and file.  These are sometimes found on the weaker of their troops positioned in the Plaguelands, though the term "weaker" is certainly to be considered in context.  The Scourge, no matter where they are, should never be underestimated.

The Argent Dawn currently offers a valor token in exchange for twenty of these insignia - an exchange I'm happy to do, provided you have earned enough scourgestones!
7810: There must be more to being a master of the arena than this!   Perhaps the Pirate who runs the event at Gurubashi will know!
Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.
8060:
Mages in our tribe are known as illusionists.  They employ powerful mojo in their incantations, often befuddling and confusing the tribe's enemies!

<Al'tabim laughs wickedly.>

It is quite the sight to see a powerful illusionist at work, bringing our enemies to their knees from their own madness!

For you to know the way of our illusionists, go to Zul'Gurub and bring back to me selected Paragons of Power.  For this, I will give you arm wraps our illusionists use to weave their spells.

Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing Primal Hakkari Bindings.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.$B$BAl'tabim the All-Seeing is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.
8160:
The League of Arathor is sparing no expense in their move to retake Arathi.  They, and all the races of the Alliance, now stream to this distant region, intent on expanding their hold from Refuge Pointe.  We must stop them, and the best means to stop them is to take their supplies.

You can help us, {name}.  Enter Arathi Basin, known for its rich mines, fertile land and skilled craftsman.  Capture and control every base you can, win the battle, and return to me with the resources you gain.
Win the battle for Arathi Basin, get an Arathi Resource Crate, and return it to Deathstalker Mortis at Hammerfall.
8310: I think I can formulate an elixir that will allow us to more readily decipher the glyphs and language of the silithid and Qiraji! What do I need? Glad you asked! I need brains! More specifically, a brain from each silithid type that inhabit the hives. Bring me brains and Rutgar's work might not be for naught.

Frankal Stonebridge at Bronzebeard's Encampment in Silithus wants you to recover a Hive'Zora Silithid Brain, Hive'Ashi Silithid Brain, and a Hive'Regal Silithid Brain. Return to Frankal when you have completed this task.
8460:
The Timbermaw are the only furbolg tribe to escape the corruption. However, many other races kill furbolg blindly now, without bothering to see if they are friend or foe. For this reason, the Timbermaw furbolg trust very few.

Are you interested in proving yourself? Drive back the corrupted Deadwood tribe of Felwood and we may one day consider you an ally. You'll find the first Deadwood tribe - warriors, pathfinders and gardeners - to my west.
Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners.  Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.
8560:
You seek to prove your worth to my kind, mortal?  Very well, perhaps we can be of mutual assistance.

The ancient sandworm, Ouro, is a being of legendary power.  He is rumored to have been created by the Old God himself as a mockery of life.

His skin is unnatural... thick, nearly impregnable, yet it's flexible and allows him to move with the speed and grace of a much smaller creature.

Bring me a sample of his skin along with other minor components and I shall craft you leggings of great power.

Bring Ouro's Intact Hide, 2 Idols of Death, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
8660:
Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of Night, 5 Clay Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
8710:
The Qiraji and their servants wield items made with the rarest and finest materials: bones from gargantuan ancient creatures, gems from the depths of the earth, metals pure and strong.

Just the sight of Qiraji artifacts fills me with an urge to practice my craft with their shattered and smelted pieces.  Prove your allegiance to the Circle, {name}, and I will make you a powerful weapon from the finest Qiraji materials.
Bring 1 Qiraji Ornate Hilt, 2  Onyx Idols, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Warden Haro in Silithus.  You must also attain Exalted reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
8760:
Dedication of this magnitude is a rarity. You have shown that your will is unfaltering, {name}. You shall be greatly rewarded for your stalwart watch over our world.

Hand me your signet ring so that I may strengthen its enchantment.
8810: Our supply of bandages in the battlefield is running dangerously low after the recent casualties we have incurred.  Obtain a batch of first-aid supplies and deliver them to Windcaller Proudhorn in Cenarion Hold.

Bring 30 Heavy Runecloth Bandages, 30 Heavy Silk Bandages and 30 Heavy Mageweave Bandages to Windcaller Proudhorn at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.  You must also bring Logistics Task Briefing X in order to complete this quest.
8910:
Well met, {class}.  I've something that might interest you.

I have in my possession a set of armor much like the one worn by those of your profession, but of much higher quality.  I'd be willing to trade the bracers for ordinary ones in exchange for a small favor.

The blood of the frostsabers and bears that inhabit Winterspring has properties I'm in need of at the moment.  Bring me a sizeable sample of it along with the bracers and a small amount of gold.  You shall find the effort worth your while.
Acquire 15 Winterspring Blood Samples and 20 gold and bring them along with a set of Shadowcraft Bracers to Deliana in Ironforge.$B
8960:
So we need to recover the rest of the medallion?  Finding Bodley's going to be a bit of a headache.  He went back to Blackrock Mountain to attempt to re-enter Blackrock Spire and never came back.

I'd suggest taking the goblin's ghost revealing device with you, as I fear the worst might have happened.
Travel to Blackrock Mountain and use the Extra-Dimensional Ghost Revealer to find Bodley near Blackrock Spire.
9010:
A truly amazing story, {name}! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
Give Mokvar your Shadowcraft Cap and Shadowcraft Tunic.
9060:
I have discovered a use for the carapace of the crypt fiend. I am able to fashion an extremely light and very deadly set of armor by combining the fragments with some of the desecrated magical armors lost in Naxxramas.

Bring me the items I require and I shall fashion for you a suit of armor the likes of which has never before been seen in our world!

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Cryptstalker Girdle if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Girdle, 8 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.$B
9110:
I make no pretenses, maggot. The darkness Plagueheart items hold could very well destroy the both of us. That is why the price is so high. If I'm going to die, it's going to be as a rich man.

And I don't give an ounce of gnoll spit how you die, only that you do as I ask. Bring me what I require and we will both benefit - or die; but I've already explained this...

Mataus the Wrathcaster at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Plagueheart Bindings if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Bindings, 6 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 1 Arcane Crystal and 1 Nexus Crystal.
9210:
Zanza can create many ancient troll enchantments with proper components! Have you heard of the Savage Guard? No, of course you haven't. Your mind is addled with the inferior elven magic.

Bring me an arcanum of elven creation so that I may destroy the aberration. Do this and the Savage Guard will be yours.
Zanza the Restless in Zul'Gurub wants an Arcanum of Focus.
76160: Maybe your skills lie with poisons, not disguises. The Harpies to the north nest in a tree which produces a resin of potent toxicity. Gather the fallen cones around the nests, then crush them into a salve. When applied to a blade this salve will sear your opponent's wounds into their flesh and turn their blood to salt.
80160: The Sparklematic 5200 is empty, awaiting a grime-encrusted object to clean and three silver coins to start!
81860: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Dream Bough, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion at the Ruins of Ravenwind. Retrieve an intelligence report from Dreamwarden Anadelle there and return to me.
82010:
The time for defense is over! We won't win unless we sabotage the competition! Their fuel! Lets see. Firebloom and Rum? THIS IS WHAT GNOMISH INGENUITY IS LOSING TO? STEEPED ALCOHOL? 

We need to find a way to sabotage the enemy fuel without them noticing. There is a flower of incredible red color, the compounds of the petals are unstable when the smallest amount of heat is applied. 

The Scarlet Crusade uses this flower in their dyes. Go to Hearthglen and find me some.
82210:
You've done it already, but we will continue to accept any troll tribal necklaces you find and are willing to turn in.  By turning them in to me, you'll continue to improve your standing amongst the Wildhammers; if you're willing to fight for us, then we'll be willing to fight for you!

I need five troll tribal necklaces for them to count, {name}.
84160:
Hail, {class}!  I can tell by your demeanor that you've seen and done much in this world.  Yet I'm willing to wager you haven't seen a piece of armor like this.

Perform a small favor for me and I'll be willing to trade it to you for an ordinary set of bracers.

I'm in need of a sizeable sample of venom drawn from the spiders and scorpions that inhabit Silithus.  Bring this to me along with a few gold coins and I'll perform the exchange.
84210:
A truly amazing story, {name}! You have my thanks, and the heartfelt gratitude of all who were involved, I can assure you. Through your efforts we are delivered from the mistakes of our past.

As to your reward, I believe I have a few things that you have definitely earned and will truly enjoy.
84560: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes, {name}. He will be expecting you...
85610:
We Zandalar know not of druidic ways; nature is to be shaped by our need, not the other way around.  Still, a haruspex is the one of us most in tune with nature, and rightly so.  To give up the ghost of a beastie is to know what it is to be one of them.  That is the real power of nature.

Bring me an offerin' of the Paragons of Power from inside Zul'Gurub, proving yourself to us.  Do this, and I'll give ya a powerful item - a belt used by many of the Zandalar's haruspices.

Strong mojo, ya mon!
85660: The Heart of Hakkar burns from within.  Although the Soulflayer is defeated, the kernel of his power yet remains in this cursed organ.
87360:
The phylactery is all that remains of the master of Naxxramas. Your better judgment dictates that you destroy the phylactery, preventing the lich from ever reforming. Thankfully, you seldom listen to that internal voice of reason.

Someone at Light's Hope will pay you hugely for this artifact. Who cares if Kel'Thuzad regenerates to full power?
87760:
I have received word back from Darnassus, {name}!

From the animal samples, we learned that the naga dominated these sea creatures to use as unwilling mounts and beasts of burden. The ones that were too obstinate, or too old or badly injured, they drove out for sport. Monstrous!

It is our sacred duty to put a stop to this!

The naga have forces in the Ruins of Mathystra, and they must be seizing threshers from off the shore. Find their beastmistress, slay her, and bring back her tools of domination!
89260:
Staying on top of your trade is crucial for maintaining a high standard of quality. Our soldiers entrust their lives to unnamed craftsmen, and to me for ensuring the quality of every piece of armor.

My task for you is simple. If you are well practiced in Tailoring, Leatherworking, or Blacksmithing, then craft a belt, purely for your own benefit. You are free to keep the result.

If you lack the skill, commission and donate any piece of the crusade's uniform instead.
89310:
It took me many years to recover from my guilt once my mind was set free from the Lich King. Once liberated by Sylvanas, I rejected the Dark Lady's offer and walked into the plaguelands alone. I wandered for months aimlessly. I'm not sure why I did it but eventually I found my way back to my family's home and what I found there was... unexpected.

Travel to the haunted village now known as Terrordale, find the northernmost house and meet me there. You'll learn the rest.
90510:
As you've seen, New Avalon boasts a significant military presence but it also offers safety and security to civilians.

If you can cobble together a more permanent disguise, consider offering a helping hand. Ingratiating yourself with the folk there could be beneficial to our efforts to reclaim the enclave, to say nothing of putting you in a position to "appropriate" some of the material and resources there, enriching yourself and depriving their war machine of crucial supplies.
90560:
<You have found a vial of foul, viscous liquid on a laboratory table. It was surrounded by various ingredients that have been meticulously measured and diced into careful portions. Though the herbs are unidentifiable, one undamaged and discolored beast heart rests nearby.

The concoction is familiar, reminiscent of recent experiments performed by the Royal Apothecary Society. If your curiosity overpowers your disgust, perhaps one of their members may be interested in your discovery.>
91610:
Meat is well and good, but a varied diet makes the body stronger.

Winter squid are in season, and can be fished from the coasts here in Azshara. I never took to angling myself. I much prefer the safety of land. Although, were you to fish some up, or obtain them via some other means, I would greatly appreciate it.
91760: The rappelling equipment indicates that there's some kind of ongoing operation on or near the walls of this dam that you interrupted.
92110:
Wow, my very first potion! Did you know that mixing those two herbs together would change the potion to a bright red color when you first started?

That was fun, but mixing a few flowers doesn't seem like the kind of alchemy Daddy does. He uses other ingredients too.

I don't know what else to use, so let's try the first thing that comes to mind! Let's see... maybe murloc eyes? That sounds so gross, but I bet something will happen.
92460:
Look at you, bright eyed and ready for adventure! We need all the help we can get here in Thendal Village and your arrival is most welcome. I imagine you are brimming with nerves for what is to come. After all, you only get to come of age once in a lifetime.

Go, seek out our village leader Rorian the Dayseeker at the entrance to the greatfather tree just west of here. He will get you started on your journey.
92860:
The High Order have done our best to avoid direct conflict with the cult, but that is clearly no longer an option. Their hostility has been clearly demonstrated, and now there are rumors of larger-scale cult movements around the island. They are clearly gearing up for something and whatever it is can't be good for the people of Zephras.

Report to Valennia Stormfist and inform her that the High Order offers our full support in Valanaar's efforts against the Al'Aketh, should the need arise.
92910: The part you managed to salvage from the harvester appears mostly intact. Someone interested in harvest golems may want to see it.
92960:
A lingering demon presence remains to the east. Among them are the hellish beasts responsible for ravaging our kin, siphoning their power to use it against our allies.

Penetrate their camp, locate these beasts and slay them. Retrieve any samples that remain.

Perhaps there is something we can learn from these efforts.
93160:
I do appreciate you stopping by to talk with me! I-If you do want to help out, I could use a bit of help gathering up acorns from the forest floor. I've gathered most of the ones close by but there sure are a lot of raptor-bird things in the forest. It's dangerous out there and I'd rather not become a giant bird's lunch!

So if you want, you could maybe gather them for me? I'll make us something tasty if you do!
93510:
It's a heavy thing to stand in Hyjal, where so many companions met their unnatural ends. The land itself echoes with grief. Craters filled with ash, memories too bitter to forget.

Yet you carry a spark from the Eastern Kingdoms, a warmth that defies this gloom! My childhood friend Tobin enlisted alongside me, and though I hold hope, I fear for what remains of his soul.

We'd spend afternoons skipping stones as kids across Lake Everstill in Redridge. Look for a shoreline anchor, and honor our pastime?
94260: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Catseye Draught, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94310: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Black Mageweave Vest, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
94360: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting oa Soul Pouch, along with information about delivery location and payment. At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
95260:
The hide is painted with broad strokes of fish guts and squid ink. It appears to depict some kind of sea monster, rising up from the waves, with a long neck. What could this beast be?

The nearest port is Powderfuse Port. If this monster is real, and lurks these waters, a sailor there has surely seen it.
95560:
<The mysterious scroll is written in a flowing script not unlike that of Darnassian. Unlike true elvish text, however, you notice something slightly... off about the flow of the words. You think you catch a faint sensation of magical energy, but it's gone before you can be sure.

You feel a small tug in your mind, nudging you towards the north end of Felwood. You don't know how you know it, but someone there needs aid.>
95810:
You pick up a fractured piece of the rock-mech automaton. It has a texture unlike anything you've touched before, a composite material of unknown makeup. This is certainly bound to be more 'device' than 'debris.'

Prospector Whelgar himself at his excavation site might have something useful to share about the relic.
96010:
Although I am sure we can attribute the damage to both pylons to the reckless centaur stomping about, I suspect the timing of their rampage resulted in the shards being separated. I know little about their quarrels, but I do know there are at least two main factions that have trespassed into Shen'dralas: the ferocious Magram and the cunning Gelkis.

Keeping these treasures in the midst of a battlefield would be unwise. By now, I am assuming they have taken their trophies back to their own villages.
96060:
Let me be the first to share that I was a master swordsman in life. I forged weapons by day and wielded them by night.

As you are quite well aware, my relationship with this particular blade is now extraordinarily complicated. Though I think I could swing it around, I'm not convinced it would be of much use unless I was fighting other spirits. Is that really of any value to me in Shen'dralas?

Nonetheless, I would like its capabilities tested and I think our forests could use a gentle culling.
96260:
Have you heard what befell the burial ground at Gloomrise? Giant spiders--rumored to have a venom so strong that it can wake the dead--have spread like wildfire. Nasty business, if you ask me.

One of the scouts dispatched to investigate returned half dead and covered in an incredibly resilient, crystalline spider silk. I harvested what I could, but I would highly value more samples of this silk for additional study.

Bring me more of this crystalline silk and I will reward you.
97010:
The rune-etched shards are prepared. Dropped from high enough, they'll shatter upon impact, ripping through armor and demon flesh.

There's a tower overlooking this wasteland. It will give us the height we need.

We climb. I'll keep to the shadows and guard your flank.

When we reach the top, signal me by making the first throw. I'll bring ruin down on them.
98310:
There are other, larger golems all around the Wetlands. They each bear inscriptions marking them as Ados, Modr, Golm, and Neru--matching the missing pieces of the Goaz Stone you found!

I'd be willing to bet if we can bring pieces of them as well, we'll reveal more of the Goaz Stone!

You'll find Ados at the Dragonmaw Gates to the east, near Grim Batol. Modr is right outside Dun Modr to the north. Golm lies beneath Grim Batol, east of Dun Algaz. Neru's behind Direforge Hill, to the northeast.
99010:
The ruin known as Dire Maul is a solemn tomb. Countless kaldorei souls have died to pay the balance of a grim bargain struck with an unthinking, uncaring evil. All in the name of maintaining the splendor and immortality of a privileged few. 

Go there and slay the beast known as Immol'thar that lies at the center of the western wing of the city. Bring me a phial of its cursed blood and break the cycle of death in that haunted place. Then I will cleanse the artifact you carry.
99160:
You may have noticed the elementals nearby. A shelf of rock and ice fell from the mountain peaks a few days ago and riled them up.

These frozen mountains are already treacherous for the average dwarf or human without the elements taking form. I am not one for fighting anymore--so any of the spirits you can kill would help make the road safer.
99210:
Ah, hail {name}! My, you've certainly grown since the last time you were at my humble stable, eh?

It would seem you have the experience ta be ridin' our fiercest and fastest rams now! Ah, I'm proud of ye.

So, you have an important choice to make. You and yer ram will traverse the world together so choose wisely! Not to worry, whatever choice you make will be the right one.

Go see the armored rams and return to me when you've made yer choice.
99260:
I was tasked to retrieve important data on the flow of elemental energy from the Overlook Standing Stones. That data is vital to our plans to safely travel between Skywall and Azeroth. Without that data to aid in our calculations, our attempts to steer our skycutter ships through the elemental plane will fail.

The data is likely lost at this point, and I'm in no state to attempt to gather it again. I told the Supreme Magister of your role in saving me, and he wishes to speak with you again.
